func TestContextReader_PasswordDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
	t.Cleanup(func() { pr.Close() })
	t.Cleanup(func() { pw.Close() })
	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
	fake := &fakeTerm{reader: pr}
	cr.term = fake
	cr.fd = 0
	defer cr.Close()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	got, err := cr.ReadPassword(ctx)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
	require.Empty(t, got)
	require.True(t, fake.restoreCalled)

	cr.mu.Lock()
	state := cr.state
	cr.mu.Unlock()
	require.Equal(t, readerStateClean, state)

	go func() { _, _ = pw.Write([]byte("next read")) }()
	got, err = cr.ReadContext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "next read", string(got))
}

func TestContextReader_CloseRestoresPassword(t *testing.T) {
	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
	t.Cleanup(func() { pr.Close() })
	t.Cleanup(func() { pw.Close() })
	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
	term := &fakeTerm{reader: pr}
	cr.term = term
	cr.fd = 0

	cr.mu.Lock()
	cr.state = readerStatePassword
	cr.previousTermState = &term.State{}
	cr.mu.Unlock()
	require.NoError(t, cr.Close())
	require.True(t, term.restoreCalled)
	require.Equal(t, readerStateClosed, cr.state)

	other := NewContextReader(pr)
	other.term = &fakeTerm{reader: pr, restoreErr: errors.New("restore failed")}
	other.fd = 0
	other.mu.Lock()
	other.state = readerStatePassword
	other.previousTermState = &term.State{}
	other.mu.Unlock()
	require.ErrorContains(t, other.Close(), "restore failed")
	require.Equal(t, readerStateClosed, other.state)
}
